يفتحلون (form VIII)
# يَفْتَحِلُونَ (yaftaḥilūna) /jaf.ta.ħi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# يُفْتَحَلُونَ (yuftaḥalūna) /juf.ta.ħa.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
